entities.title: Dictator (1983)
entities.summary: The ZX Spectrum 48K game by Don Priestley, published by DK'Tronics, whose rules Samosa keeps.
entities.relevance: RULES.md restates its behaviour in the remake's own words. Only the spec and verify role reads the original and the baseline; the tape image is Spectrum Computing's entry 1388.
